timers.text: 🏁 Join the GreMi Gang on Discord: a racing community where we help each other get faster, plus all the news about GreMi and the streams. https://discord.gg/bDga7v97Qq
📊 Lap times, results and head to heads from the races on stream: https://gremigaming.github.io/race-stats/

🏎️ Looking for a sim rig? GreMi partners with Simgasm: great cockpits at a fair price. Get 10% off with code GREMI10 at https://simgasm.com/gremi_gaming . Bought one? Show GreMi your order for a free sub and the Simgasm Buyer role on Discord!
💜 Enjoying the racing? Hit follow so you don't miss the next stream!

🎁 Weekly giveaway: a €10 gift card (Steam, EA, Xbox or PlayStation)! It's drawn 10 minutes after the 5th new sub. {giveaway} Join the Discord, get the Prize Hunter role and press Enter in #giveaways: https://discord.gg/bDga7v97Qq
💜 Why sub? No ads on stream, extra entries in the weekly giveaway on Discord, the subs-only chat on Discord, and your own custom welcome sound and alert every time you join the stream!

ads.notice_lobby: 📺 Quick ad break while we line up for the next race, back in {length} seconds!

_about: Race Control's chat messages. every = minutes between clock runs (none = only on events, commands or questions); first = not before this minute of the stream; quiet = only after this many minutes without any Race Control message; skip_after = not when that message went out that recently; events = minutes to wait after: new_chatter, stream_end, hidden_driver, ad, sub; cooldown = minutes between event runs of this message; commands = anyone can type them; ask = question pattern; ask_text = the answer to a command or question if it differs; game = only while the stream category contains it.
